rag_preprocessing_visualization.purpose: v17 NEW - Guidance on how to visualize RAG retrieval in ASCII trees (clarifies RAG is pre-processing, not reasoning)
rag_preprocessing_visualization.principle: RAG appears BEFORE transformer layers as context augmentation, not as a reasoning branch within CoT/ToT

ascii_tree_placement.correct: Show RAG retrieval as a separate pre-processing block ABOVE the input token layer
ascii_tree_placement.incorrect: Do NOT show RAG as a ToT branch competing with other reasoning paths

rag_preprocessing_visualization.visualization_template:
🔎 RAG PRE-PROCESSING (v16/v17)
                ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                │ Hop 1: {hop1_query}            │
                │ Sources: {hop1_sources}         │
                │ Signal Quality: {hop1_quality}  │
                ├─────────────────────────────────┤
                │ Hop 2: {hop2_query}            │
                │ Sources: {hop2_sources}         │
                │ Signal Quality: {hop2_quality}  │
                ├─────────────────────────────────┤
                │ [Hop 3 if applicable]          │
                ├─────────────────────────────────┤
                │ Synthesized Context:           │
                │ {context_summary}               │
                │ Confidence: {rag_confidence}   │
                └─────────────┬───────────────────┘
                              │
                              ↓
                    🔥 INPUT: [RAG-augmented context + user query]
                                    |
                    ┌───────────────┴───────────────┐
                    | 📊 Slide 1: [Task]            |
                    | 👤 General Analyst (CoT)      |
                    | Layers 1-3: Compression       |
                    | Conf: [value]                 |
                    └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                    |
                              [CoT/ToT continues...]
rag_preprocessing_visualization.key_distinction: RAG enriches INPUT (context layer), CoT/ToT processes INPUT (reasoning layer). They are orthogonal, not competitive.
rag_preprocessing_visualization.note: When SHOW_DETAILED_REASONING=OFF, RAG pre-processing still documented in section_2b_rag_retrieval but ASCII tree omitted
